notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in their hand.
easyPrerequisites: Dual Casting and Umbral Mantle are attached to the same creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Jeska's Will.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding {R} for each card in an opponent's hand
Activate the creature by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.
